review_notes: Each reference subscriber uses a distinct live hover binder in the adapter. Actual production binds one Markdown container and parent controllers own session/scope/realtime refresh. These contracts cannot establish a visible stale-preview regression.
The subscriber exception case only fails on a logging count; delivery to another tooltip succeeds.
Voice recorder stops after ten minutes, uses monotonic elapsed time, and supplies a fixed 512-sample buffer. Empty pasted text cannot pass the large-paste threshold.
The actual pixelation action paints solid black rather than downsampling the region. Long single-line paste offer uses line count rather than character count.
Shared authenticated fixture injection is restricted to the scratch origin; about:blank pageerror regression was observed red then green.
